topic: ML API frequency request validation setup
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main topics: a complex Python script for session randomization and forecasting, and the development of an ML API frequency request validation tool. The initial code provided by [p1] details a process to generate daily sessions by combining actual sensor data with simulated/forecasted data (using 7 days prior data for substitution and 8 days prior data for device ID checks). This script is not immediately actionable due to high workload priorities.

Regarding the ML API, it was decided that implementing automatic validation of request schemas (checking for required fields and correct data types) would be beneficial. [p1] will coordinate with someone named Ruslan regarding scheduling this task for staging.
decisions: The ML API frequency request validation tool needs to be built.
The work on the ML API validation tool will be scheduled for tomorrow.
action_items: [p1] to write up and coordinate with Ruslan regarding switching the ML API validation task to staging environment.
